00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000006.title: Mara Vale
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000006.synopsis: A cartographer who trusts measurements more than memories. She left Bellwether at sixteen.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000006.notes: Her arc is about accepting uncertainty without losing her sense of self.

00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000008.title: Tomas Reyes
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000008.synopsis: The ferryman who took Mara’s father to the island and has never said what was spoken on the crossing.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000008.notes: Never lets him answer a question directly. Weather first, then people.

00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000009.title: Elin Marsh
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000009.synopsis: The lighthouse keeper who drew the first map of the changing coastline and still visits the places that vanish.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000009.notes: Warm and unhurried. She chooses which truths arrive first.
